notes: Tamil Nadu reported the highest number of Detenus (1962), who had been
detained and kept in various prisons, during 1998. The other states, which
reported considerable detention of such inmates, were Uttar Pradesh (6871),
Gujarat (426), Maharashtra (407) and Jammu & Kashmir (303). Tamil Nadu
reported 232 female detenus in their Jails which was the highest among all States
The incidence of Mentally ill kept in jails were considerably large in the
States of Madhya Pradesh (99) and Rajasthan (56). Only the state of Madhya
Pradesh reported the presence of 6 female Mentally ill prisoners in custody
